mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 15.0% over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 15.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 1 month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), the Federal Reserve implements monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above its 12-month moving average signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) over 1 month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0 for 1 month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening amid labor market stress, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise for 1 month, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annually), economic momentum peaks and recession risks rise, causing S&P 500 underperformance and negative forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annually, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
